description: 1024x16 block RAM with a registered read port

log_contains: ERROR: Hold/min time violation for clock '[^']*CLKARDCLK'

why: KNOWN GAP since yosys 0.69 (oss-cad-suite 2026-09-27): nextpnr checks the RAMB data-in hold with the NO_CHANGE value for every WRITE_MODE (openXC7/nextpnr#64), and this READ_FIRST block, placed from the 0.69 netlist, ends with DIADI paths short enough to trip that false hold: nextpnr exits 1. Fixed by openXC7/nextpnr#65; when the engine carries it this flow passes, the guard trips, and the test goes back to a positive one.
